issues.title: [Bug]: recursive type through an xml type parameter overflows the stack
issues.output:
runtime: goroutine stack exceeds 1000000000-byte limit
runtime: sp=0x178caea606f8 stack=[0x178caea60000, 0x178ccea60000]
fatal error: stack overflow
github.com/ballerina-nutcracker/ballerina/semantics/internal/types.resolveBTypeInner({0x22cfd00, 0x178c8e2f9e00}, 0x0, {0x22aee48, 0x178c8e171880}, 0xdc19)
issues.edge_case_reason: Self-referential type definition through an xml<T> type parameter is a rarely used construct.
issues.reasoning: Reproduces on main: Go 'fatal error: stack overflow' in semantics/internal/types.resolveBTypeInner before any diagnostic, so frontend + frontend-crash. No duplicate found (related closed #1114, union alias cycle). Spec check (clean-context subagent): Valid: xml<T> only requires T to be a subtype of xml and type definitions may be recursive; Y equals xml<xml:Element>, so the program should print <a/>.

issues.title: [Bug]: array: prefix resolves without importing lang.array
issues.edge_case_reason: Only affects invalid programs that use the array: prefix without importing ballerina/lang.array; valid programs are unaffected.
issues.reasoning: Reproduces on main: the program compiles, BIR is generated and it prints 2; a missing diagnostic for an invalid program is a frontend bug (bir_ok=false because BIR should not be produced). Related: #1678; no duplicate. Spec check (clean-context subagent): Valid: 'array' is not a predeclared prefix (spec 8.1), so without importing ballerina/lang.array the prefix is undefined and compilation must fail.

issues.output:
fatal[INTERNAL_ERROR]: transformExprKind: unsupported node type *st.RemoteMethodCallActionNode
  --> i1694.bal:11:29
   |
11 |     int[] a = from int i in cl->items() select i;
   |                             ^^^^^^^^^^^
ballerina: compilation contains errors
issues.edge_case_reason: A remote method call as a query's source collection is ordinary client code.
issues.reasoning: Reproduces on main: fatal[INTERNAL_ERROR] transformExprKind: unsupported node type *st.RemoteMethodCallActionNode (an internal-error diagnostic, not a process crash, so no frontend-crash). A comment adds start/wait actions in the from clause hitting the same code path. Related but not duplicates: #1651 (join/collect), #1556 (let), #1244 (start in cast/select). Spec check (clean-context subagent): Valid: query-action-or-expr allows from-action-clause := from typed-binding-pattern in action-or-expr, so a remote method call action is allowed; prints [1,2].

issues.title: [Bug]: local variable named 'self' in an object field-initializer lambda is rejected as already defined
issues.output:
error[SEMANTIC_ERROR]: Variable already defined: self
 --> i1691.bal:6:9
  |
6 |         int self = 2;
  |         ^^^^^^^^^^^^^
ballerina: compilation contains errors
issues.edge_case_reason: Declaring a local named 'self' inside a lambda in an object field initializer is an unusual combination.
issues.reasoning: Reproduces on main: SEMANTIC_ERROR 'Variable already defined: self'. Related: #1562. No duplicate. Spec check (clean-context subagent): Unclear, leaning valid: the spec never reserves 'self' as a keyword and only binds it in method bodies; no self is in scope in a field-initializer lambda, so 'int self = 2' is an ordinary local (jBallerina's lexer treats self as a keyword, the only source of doubt).

ballerina: compilation contains errors
issues.edge_case_reason: Non-isolated service declaration attached to a listener whose service type is isolated is a common library pattern (hit when porting ballerina/messaging).

Spec check (clean-context subagent): Valid: a service-decl has the semantics of an object-constructor-expr with a type-reference to S; since S (Svc) is an isolated object type, the constructor is explicitly isolated, so it compiles and prints ok.

issues.output:

 --> i1669.bal:4:13
  |
4 |     int x = check j.a;
  |             ^^^^^^^^^
ballerina: compilation contains errors
issues.edge_case_reason: 'int x = check j.a' on a json value is a very common idiom.
issues.reasoning: Reproduces on main: SEMANTIC_ERROR 'incompatible type: expected int, got json'. Related: #1323 (value:ensureType); no duplicate. Spec check (clean-context subagent): Valid: spec 6.33 lax-check rule treats check Expr as check val:ensureType(Expr, int), so the program prints 5 and true.

issues.title: [Bug]: decimal:floor/ceiling produce a decimal with a coefficient longer than 34 digits
issues.reasoning: Reproduces on main: floor/ceiling of 1e40d print a 41-digit integer. BIR is correct (plain floor/ceiling calls); the bug is in the lang.decimal implementation, so langlib. No duplicate (related closed #1403). Spec check (clean-context subagent): Valid: a decimal coefficient must fit in 34 digits (spec 5.2), so floor/ceiling of 1e40d must keep a positive exponent (1E+40, 1.5E+40); a 41-digit integer is not a valid decimal.

issues.title: [Bug]: float:max/float:min ignore NaN when the other argument is ±Infinity
issues.reasoning: Reproduces on main: max(NaN, Infinity) gives Infinity, min(NaN, -Infinity) gives -Infinity. BIR is correct; the bug is in the lang.float implementation, so langlib. No duplicate. Spec check (clean-context subagent): Valid: lang.float docs say max/min return NaN if any arg is NaN, regardless of Infinity or argument order.

notes: All 11 new triage issues reproduce on main 8d7d45394. #1671/#1673 depend on open #1294 (resource declarations in object type descriptors hit an INTERNAL_ERROR on main); their reported symptoms appear only with PR #1662 applied. #1694 is a sibling of #1651/#1556/#1244 (actions in other query clauses); no common parent issue exists.
